desc: A burnished metallic token bearing an ancient glyph for "far."

desc: A burnished metallic token bearing an ancient glyph for "strength."

2823.name: Iridium
desc: A rare precious metal that is exceptionally durable and heat-resistant.

2824.name: Shagreen
desc: Unusually durable leather of indeterminate animal origin. Curious bumps dot the surface.

2825.name: Cambric
desc: An elegant woven fabric that sparkles brilliantly under light.

2826.name: Mandra Scale
desc: A charming brass scale in the shape of a mandragora's leaf crown.

2827.name: Rgd. Gld. Thread
desc: This gold thread is sturdy enough to support the weight of even the burliest bugbear.

2828.name: Herensugue Skin
desc: The supple yet resilient skin of Herensugue.

2829.name: Radiant Velvet
desc: This square of velvet is so brilliantly colored as to seem to radiate light.

2830.name: Bastet Fang
desc: The saber-like cuspid of Bastet, sharp enough to pierce even the toughest-skinned prey.

2831.name: Yel. Brass Chain
desc: Of higher purity than ordinary brass, this chain shines a brilliant yellow.

2832.name: Samwell's Shank
desc: The giant leg bone of Slumbering Samwell. If only he could have stayed awake, it might still be attached to his body.

2833.name: Thunder Coral
desc: A piece of coral with sharp, jagged branches that resemble bolts of lightning.

2834.name: Immortal Molt
desc: The molt of a highlander lizard, shed in a climactic battle with another of its kind. There can be only one!

2835.name: Dahu Hair
desc: Hair from the mane of a dahu. No matter how hard you try to straighten it, it always reverts to a twisted, gnarled state.

2836.name: Woolly Pelage
desc: A pelage from a giant ram so thick and fluffy it could keep an adventurer warm on even the coldest nights.

2837.name: Ratatoskr Pelt
desc: The pelt of the elusive Ratatoskr, sought after by many a hunter.

2838.name: Ephemeral Cloth
desc: A piece of cloth so delicate and thin it seems about to fade from existence at any moment.

2839.name: Coquecigr. Skin
desc: The absurdly grotesque skin of the fabled coquecigrue.

2840.name: Imperial Topaz
desc: A resplendent yellow topaz of peerless cut and clarity.

2841.name: Qdv. Silv. Ingot
desc: An ingot of silver refined using Quadav smelting techniques.

2842.name: Flawed Garnet
desc: A garnet so murky and rough that it resembles little more than a misshapen lump of red stone.

2843.name: Lineadach
desc: A particularly elegant square of linen woven by a Fomor.

2844.name: Penumbral Brass
desc: An ingot of brass with oddly patterned streaks of black that appear to shift like shadows.

2845.name: Aramid Fiber
desc: An unnatural-seeming fiber that is curiously resilient given its thin and supple nature.

2846.name: Hefty Oak Lbr.
desc: An exceptionally heavy and sturdy-looking piece of oak lumber.

2847.name: Blue Jasper
desc: A jasper of brilliant blue, so rarely seen that many consider it but a myth.

2848.name: Grimy Brz. Sheet
desc: This bronze sheet is so filthy with dirt and grime that it turns the stomach even to touch it.

2849.name: Likho Talon
desc: The sharp, dagger-like talon of a likho.

2850.name: Sahagin Gold
desc: An ingot smelted from alluvial gold retrieved by the Sahagin from an ancient river bed.

2851.name: Bukktooth
desc: The massive and sturdy molar of a rambukk, worn down from chewing large quantities of cud.

2852.name: Tenebrium
desc: A shadowy black ingot smelted by demons in their netherworldly forge.

2853.name: Malebolge Mand.
desc: A hellishly warped mandrel said to have the power to twist its possessor's soul.

2854.name: Stately Crab Sh.
desc: This massive shell from a rare species of land crab is so hard it feels like metal to the touch.

2855.name: Mahogany Htwd.
desc: The darkest and hardest wood from the center of an ancient mahogany tree.

2856.name: Ensang. Cloth
desc: A bloodstained cloth that belonged to a ghost.

2857.name: T. Tama-hagane
desc: A lump of the purest steel, wrought in a manner taught in a land far to the east.

2858.name: Wolfram Steel
desc: A highly durable steel, refined through methods long since forgotten.

2859.name: Cobalt Ore
desc: Ore containing the lustrous metal cobalt. When processed with other metals, it produces a brilliant blue hue.

2860.name: Plumbago
desc: Metallic in appearance and slick to the touch, this mineral is used to harness and channel the power of lightning.

2861.name: Timeworn Talisman
desc: The years have not been kind to this Ephramadian talisman. An image of the Dark Rider embossed on its surface is barely distinguishable.

2862.name: Kingdom Waystone
desc: This otherwise nondescript gray stone glows with a faint blue light that feels somehow familiar...

2874.name: Lambent Scale
desc: This delicate scale from the wing of a pixie glows with a soothing light. It is said to have curative powers.

2875.name: Ethereal Squama
desc: A delicate scale from the wing of a pixie, so thin and tenuous as to be almost imperceptible.

2876.name: Muculent Ingot
desc: This ingot of pure gold is coated in a viscous, slimy substance that clings tenaciously to its surface.

2877.name: Befouled Silver
desc: Years spent in the possession of baleful monsters have lent an ill-boding glint to this once-pure precious metal.

2878.name: Scarlet Kadife
desc: Luxurious and smooth to the touch, this fabric is such a deep red as to make one wonder if it were dyed with blood.

2879.name: Igneous Barnacle
desc: Jagged to the touch, this barnacle from the shell of the massive Krabkatoa is coated with a layer of hardened magma.

2880.name: Kidney Stone
desc: A tawny crystalline stone recovered from the body of the antlion Orcus, quite beautiful despite its unpleasant origin.

2881.name: Eye of Verthandi
desc: A brilliant, flawless gem of otherworldly beauty that was a treasured possession of Verthandi.

2882.name: Baby Blobdingnag
desc: A smallish globule of red slime split off from Blobdingnag. If left alone, will it grow to the size of its parent...?

2883.name: Ruthven's Nail
desc: The dagger-like fingernail of the fearsome vampyr Lord Ruthven, still specked with the blood of one of his unfortunate victims.

2884.name: Krabkatoa Shell
desc: The massive, still-smoldering shell of the gargantuan Krabkatoa, as solid and durable as a slab of volcanic rock.

2885.name: Orcus Mandible
desc: The imposing mandible of the mammoth antlion Orcus, suited to instantaneously crushing the life out of unwitting prey.

2886.name: Mildewy Ingot
desc: The excess mold growth on this shabby-looking ingot makes it impossible to discern what sort of metal it originally was.

2887.name: Decayed Ingot
desc: A decaying ingot of some indeterminate metal that feels as if it is about to crumble to dust in your hand.

2888.name: Sanguinet
desc: A translucent mass of tissue found protruding from the body of certain vorageans. Though slightly cracked, it retains a vivid scarlet hue.

2889.name: Limule Pincer
desc: The spiny pincer of a limule.

2890.name: Clionid Wing
desc: The delicate, translucent wing of a clionid.

2891.name: Dried Chigoe
desc: The withered husk of a dead chigoe.

2892.name: R. Mutton Chop
desc: This bloody slab of ram meat exudes an overpowering raw odor.

2893.name: G. Blk. Tiger Fang
desc: The oversized fang of a gargantuan species of black tiger.

2894.name: Trophy Shield
desc: A shield claimed by a Gigas off the body of a particularly renowned adventurer it slew.

2895.name: Oversized Sock
desc: This oversized sock of a Gigas reeks of blood and sweat. Far too large (and rancid) to be worn except by Gigas.

2896.name: Massive Armband
desc: A weighted armband used by Gigas in building their hulking muscles. Far too heavy to be worn except by Gigas.

2897.name: Tr. Insect Wing
desc: An insect wing so transparent as to be almost invisible to the eye.

2898.name: Piceous Scale
desc: A pitch-black scale that seems to smother the light around it.

2899.name: Winter Puk Egg
desc: Puk eggs laid in winter, such as this one, are said to be particularly rich in nutrients.

2900.name: Bug-eaten Hat
desc: This hole-ridden hat of a Poroggo appears to have provided a meal for many an insect. Only Poroggos can equip it.

2901.name: Giant Agaricus
desc: A particularly large and earthy agaricus mushroom.

2902.name: Filthy Gnole Claw
desc: This massive gnole claw is caked with dirt and grime.

2903.name: Eft Blood
desc: Blood from an eft, said to be so vile that even leeches steer clear of it.

2904.name: G. Slug Eyestalk
desc: The long, slimy eyestalk of a giant slug.

2905.name: Moonglow Cloth
desc: A gossamer astral fabric that glows only under the light of the moon. Far too delicate to use in crafting.

2906.name: Rotting Eyeball
desc: An eyeball from a treant that has begun to decompose.

2907.name: Tiny Morbol Vine
desc: A curiously small morbol vine.

2908.name: Oblivispore
desc: A poisonous fungus said to wipe clean the memory of any who eats it. Not suitable for consumption.

2909.name: Snakeskin Moss
desc: A curious mottled moss that had been growing from the back of a goobbue.

2910.name: Arm. Dragonhorn
desc: The massive horn of a wivre, of fearsome size and sharpness.

2911.name: Ripped Eft Skin
desc: A skin that appears to have been savagely ripped from the body of the eft it once belonged to.

2912.name: Gt. Bugard Tusk
desc: The particularly gargantuan tusk of a bugard.

2913.name: Clouded Lens
desc: A murky lens from the eye of an Ahriman.

2914.name: Murmuring Glob
desc: A small globule rumored to be the soul of a deep sea creature. Place it by your ear, and you can hear the sound of a murmuring stream...

2915.name: H.Q. Cli. Wing
desc: A particularly durable clionid wing.

2916.name: H.Q. Lim. Pincer
desc: A particularly sharp limule pincer.

2917.name: Bl. Hecteye
desc: The bloodshot eyeball of a hecteyes.

2918.name: Baleful Skull
desc: The cursed skull of a corpselight.

2919.name: Bloody Fang
desc: The fang of a bat, flecked with fresh blood.

2920.name: Alkaline Humus
desc: The strong alkaline concentration of this humus renders it highly unsuitable for gardening.

2921.name: V. Scorp. Stinger
desc: Still dripping with potent venom, this scorpion stinger must be handled with care.

2922.name: Eft Egg
desc: In spite of (or perhaps because of?) the slight sulphurous odor it exudes, eft eggs such as this one are considered a delicacy.

2923.name: Ctrice. Tailmeat
desc: Meat from the tail of a cockatrice. Stringy and flavorless, it is quite unpopular among culinarians.

2924.name: Shk. Whisker
desc: This whisker cut from the face of a coeurl pulsates with energy in your hand.

2925.name: Resilient Mane
desc: A particularly pliant and durable manticore mane.

2926.name: Moaning Vestige
desc: A fragment of some unidentifiable organic substance that emits a faint moaning sound.

2927.name: Glavoid Shell
desc: The massive shell of a glavoid.

2928.name: 2Lf. Chloris Bud
desc: An oversized flower from the crown of a chloris.

2929.name: Helm of Briareus
desc: An imposing helm that once guarded the head of the legendary Gigas Briareus. Only wearable by Gigas.

2930.name: Carabosse's Gem
desc: A small yet tasteful gem that belonged to the evil pixie queen Carabosse.

2931.name: Fistl. Discharge
desc: A thick, foul-smelling liquid expelled from a fistule.

2932.name: Kukulkan's Fang
desc: The massive fang of Kukulkan, capable of impaling a knight clean through his armor.

2933.name: Chukwa's Egg
desc: Laid by Chukwa, this egg is several orders of magnitude larger than a typical adamantoise egg.

2934.name: Manan. Necklet
desc: The oversized necklet of a manananggal. An incantation of warding prevents any but its original owner from equipping it.

2935.name: Marvin's Pelage
desc: The ratty, flea-ridden pelage of Mangy-tailed Marvin.

2936.name: Chasmic Stinger
desc: A dagger-like stinger harvested from the body of a chasmic hornet.

2937.name: Raskovnik Vine
desc: The giant vine of a raskovnik.

2938.name: Bakka's Wing
desc: A wing clipped from the imp lord Bakka.

2939.name: Cuelebre's Horn
desc: The fearsome horn of the legendary serpent Cuelebre.

2940.name: Mictlan. Habit
desc: The dark robes worn by the necromancer Mictlantecuhtli while performing his dark rituals. Not wearable by living beings.

2941.name: Keesha Pamama
desc: A pamama purloined from the possession of the fruit-fancying Keesha Poppo.

2942.name: Mikey's Nugget
desc: A hefty silver nugget removed from the stomach of Megamaw Mikey. Likely the cause of a mega-serious case of indigestion.

2943.name: Balaur Skull
desc: The ghastly skull of a balaur wyvern.

2944.name: Lieje Lantern
desc: Once carried by a Tonberry Lieje, this lantern still burns with an ominous, hateful light.

2945.name: Shriveled Wing
desc: The wing of a clionid, now shriveled from excess exposure to the air.

2946.name: Tarnished Pincer
desc: The pincer of a limule, now tarnished from excess exposure to the air.

2947.name: Exorcised Skull
desc: This corpselight skull has been cleansed of the curse that once resided in it.

2948.name: Acidic Humus
desc: Mildly acidic in composition, this humus is well suited for gardening.

2949.name: Quiv. Eft Egg
desc: This eft egg seems about to hatch at any moment...

2950.name: Smooth Whisker
desc: Drained of electricity, this coeurl whisker is soft and smooth to the touch.

2951.name: Malachite
desc: This spectacular green-colored mineral shimmers brilliantly even in dim light.

2952.name: M. Counteragent
desc: A gaseous substance that acts to temporarily disperse miasmas.

2953.name: Viscous Spittle
desc: A slimy substance expectorated by a rare species of arachnid. Can be used as an adhesive.

2954.name: Powder Casket
desc: A small casket of gunpowder. Dampened from time spent underwater, it is likely unusable in its current state.

2955.name: Kindred's Crest
desc: An elaborate crest belonging to the uppermost nobility of the Kindred.

2956.name: H. Kindred Crest
desc: Surreal, nightmarish patterns adorn this crest, symbolizing a Kindred house of the purest lineage.

2957.name: S. Kindred Crest
desc: The demonically frightful patterns etched into this crest skillfully convey the power possessed by the unholiest of Kindred houses.

2958.name: Kupon W-E85
desc:
A prize redemption coupon from the Mog Bonanza event. Issued by the Mog House Management Union (MHMU).
Tradeable for level 85 empyrean weapons.

2959.name: Kupon A-RJob
desc:
A prize redemption coupon from the Mog Bonanza event. Issued by the Mog House Management Union (MHMU).
Tradeable for job-specific Dynamis accessories.

2960.name: Water Lily
desc: The delicate, light purple blossom of a water lily.

2961.name: Sanguine Spike
desc: The fearsome spike of a peiste, dripping with both venom and the blood of the creature's prey.

2962.name: Itzpapa. Scale
desc: A glossy black scale resembling obsidian, harvested from the wing of Itzpapalotl.

2963.name: Ulhuadshi's Fang
desc: A massive fang extracted from the mouth of the giant sandworm Ulhuadshi.

2964.name: Sobek's Skin
desc: The skin of the gargantuan bugard Sobek, as rugged as the face of a mountain.

2965.name: Cirein. Lantern
desc: The eerie light stalk of Cirein-croin, employed by this fearsome deep sea hunter to lure prey of all sizes.

2966.name: Bukhis's Wing
desc: The massive wing of the gargantuan taurus known as Bukhis.

2967.name: Sedna's Tusk
desc: The overgrown tusk of the ruszor Sedna, so sharp and sturdy that it can cut through glaciers.

2968.name: Daybreak Soul
desc: The remnant of a soul lost in the dying world of Abyssea. It glows faintly only in the early morning hours.

2969.name: Twilight Soul
desc: The remnant of a soul lost in the dying world of Abyssea. It glows faintly only in the wee hours of the night.

2970.name: Mokujin
desc:
A ninjutsu tool
used in casting "Migawari."

2971.name: Inoshishinofuda

2972.name: Shikanofuda

2973.name: Chonofuda

2974.name: Trump Card
desc:
A special technique has been used to
imbue this card with the energies of all elements.

2975.name: Manigordo Tusk
desc: The keen-edged, oversized cuspid of a manigordo.

2976.name: Badlands Salt
desc: A flavorful salt found in the shell of a desert-dwelling crab.

2977.name: Punch Bug
desc: A rare and remarkable insect that, despite its minuscule size, is capable of boring holes in the hardest rocks and shells.
